sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel appearing for the appellant submitted that appellant is innocent and he is in jail since 13.07.2023.
There is long delay in lodging of FIR.
According to prosecution story, appellant is said to have promised the prosecutrix to marry and thereafter, established relationship with her.
Appellant was having love affair with the prosecutrix.
As their relationship turned sour prosecutrix falsely implicated the appellant in the case.
In these circumstances, appellant may be released on bail.
4. Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the bail application and submitted that prosecutrix was pregnant with 24 weeks.
Appellant promised to marry and on basis of said false promise established relationship with prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, appellant may not be released on bail.

5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and also the fact that prosecutrix is major aged about 20 years, she has lodged report after delay when she became pregnant, I find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.
Hence, this criminal appeal filed by appellant is allowed.

7. It is directed that on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) by the appellant along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned, the appellant be released on bail.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE shabana Date: 2023.09.19 15:27:27 +05'30'
